International Cheese Federation Blog: News, Certifications, and Education
This page features recent articles from the International Cheese Federation, covering topics such as professional certifications (Certified Cheesemonger, Sensory Evaluation, Cheese Foundations), industry news (milk prices, exports), member spotlights, educational opportunities (workshops, financial literacy), and advocacy efforts regarding labeling standards.
